newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Lufthansa to take 20 pct in Manila airport.
newsitem.headline: Lufthansa to take 20 pct in Manila airport.

text.p: Lufthansa AG is expected to take a direct 20 percent stake in a consortium that will build a modern passenger terminal at the Manila international airport, an official of the consortium said on Thursday.

The official, who declined to be named, said the consortium led by People's Air Cargo and Warehousing Co Inc (Paircargo) is also looking for another foreign firm to take up the other 20 percent stake.
A Japanese company and a Korean firm had expressed interest to participate in the multi-billion peso project.

The Paircargo group will have to put up $150 million as initial investment for the build-operate-transfer scheme. The equity structure must be firmed up before February 17 when the Philippine government signs the contract with the consortium.
Aside from Paircargo, the other local partners include Security Bank Corp and Philippine Airport and Ground Service, a joint venture between Lufthansa and Paircargo.
